name: Equnico SE
summary: Equnico SE, along with its various subsidiaries, operates within the construction sector across Estonia, Poland, Uzbekistan, and the broader Central and Eastern European region. The company's extensive construction activities encompass the development of civil engineering projects and the erection of reinforced concrete structures. It also specializes in producing mineral-asphalt mixtures for road foundations and manufacturing steel structures designed for power, industrial, and civil utility networks. Furthermore, Equnico SE undertakes the construction and modernization of power line installations and power stations, as well as supplying essential materials and equipment for infrastructure investments. Beyond its core building operations, the firm offers a range of auxiliary services, including office management, telecommunications, financial advice, consulting, courier delivery, and marketing support. Its diverse clientele includes businesses in construction, energy, transport, and waste storage and disposal, alongside both private individuals and corporate clients. Originally established in 1950 as Resbud SE, the company officially changed its name to Equnico SE in September 2024 and maintains its headquarters in Modlniczka, Poland.
